summary: Independent targeted testing passes on corrected integrated commit ad1c323: the finished SaaS landing, reveal and reduced-motion behavior, all workspaces and the Maria/caregiver journey retain prior comprehensive passing evidence, while final production-browser retesting confirms exact 44px mobile dock targets, visible keyboard focus, full footer-control clearance and hit-testing, safe responsive behavior, and zero horizontal overflow.

tests.notes: Reviewed exact integrated commit ad1c3231697556ec77d3fb4c4a9ef21c4ae63821. The production change since the preceding tester report is limited to a shared mobile document-end clearance rule in frontend/src/index.css; the other changes are focused browser coverage and the frontend report. TypeScript passed, and the isolated-port focused Playwright regression passed 1/1. Direct production-browser measurement confirmed Home, Patient, Staff, Caregiver, and Graph are each exactly 44x44 CSS px at both 320x568 and 390x844, have the expected accessible names, accept keyboard focus, and render a 2px solid outline with 3px offset. The app reserves 82.25px mobile document-end padding. The focused footer Reduce motion control clears the dock by 74.203125px at 320x568 and 74.890625px at 390x844; all six sampled points across the control, including bottom center, hit-test to the BUTTON. At both widths, document scrollWidth equals clientWidth. At 768x1024, the dock is hidden, shared clearance resolves to 0px, and width remains exact. An initial ad-hoc audit attempted programmatic focus immediately after mouse interaction and correctly did not establish focus-visible keyboard modality; the decisive rerun pressed Tab before focus and passed every focus assertion. Prior independent comprehensive evidence remains applicable to unaffected behavior: focused Vitest passed 4 files/14 tests, TypeScript and the production build passed, isolated full Playwright passed all 3 original scenarios covering reveal/SaaS/overflow, OS reduced motion, all eight staff destinations, the complete Maria journey, caregiver DOM exclusion, and reset, and a full 1440x900 landing wheel trace recorded no long tasks. Subsequent production changes were confined to mobile dock target sizing and document-end clearance, each independently retested here.

notes_for_next_agent: Run repository verification against the exact post-report commit; this report establishes independent TARGETED evidence for the current implementation revision.

The final mobile geometry is intentionally explicit: 44x44 dock targets, 82.25px mobile document-end clearance in the tested environment, more than 74px between the focused footer control and dock, and no page overflow at 320px or 390px.
The shared clearance disables at the 768px breakpoint alongside the mobile dock, avoiding unnecessary desktop spacing.
No tester-owned test file was needed because the frontend's focused Playwright regression plus an independent production-browser geometry/hit-test decisively cover the corrected boundary.
